Thanks Priya — resume looks good.

1) We can run a split/"asymmetric" agenda across two half-days to minimize panel fatigue. Proposal below is tuned to keep the candidate comfortable and keep each interviewer under 3 hours/day.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Day 1 (Tue): 12:30–13:15 — Culture/Team fit (30m)
               13:30–14:30 — Systems deep-dive (60m)
               14:45–15:15 — Short break / async notes
               15:15–16:00 — Resume walkthrough (45m)

- Day 2 (Wed): 12:00–13:00 — Distributed systems design (60m)
               13:15–14:00 — Small-team pairing exercise (45m)
               14:15–15:00 — Final Q&A + wrap (45m)

2) Evaluator shift handoff: Jonas can own the Day 1 debrief (15m buffer after 16:00) and Neha can own Day 2 debrief. Marcus Lin (I'll add him once he confirms) will be the score consolidation owner.

3) AV/runbook: We'll do a 10-minute AV check with Alex 24 hours before the first slot. Can you share the candidate's preferred video client? We use Google Meet by default; if candidate needs Zoom that's fine.

4) Can you confirm candidate's time zone (PT) and whether they want a one-day compression? If candidate prefers two half-days, we'll keep it asymmetric as above.

If that works I will: (a) lock interviewers into the slots; (b) create the calendar invites with the panel list; (c) attach a short runbook for interviewers.

Best,
Hannah
